description.value: Outbound Cycle is a locally owned, rider-run bike shop that has anchored West Kelowna's cycling community for over 30 years, serving as the exclusive Rocky Mountain dealer for the area. Positioned near popular trailheads including Smith Creek, Crawford Trails, Gillard, and McDougall Rim, it offers sales across mountain bikes, e-bikes, and scooters alongside full certified mechanic services. Touring cyclists will find a well-stocked shop with brands spanning the full range of accessories, plus mountain bike and e-bike rentals for visitors arriving without wheels.

address.value: #101 3011 Louie Drive, West Kelowna, BC V4T 3E2
